repairs.reason: Keep total, used, remaining obligations, and reserved slots as separate visual facts.
Show only one consented CONFIRMED visit instead of pre-confirming all future N visits.
Make actual completion the point that changes used and remaining, not a proposal or hold.
Separate reschedule/cancel, no-show, and partial completion without crossing the main cycle.
